assumptions: The map, its nodes, the keys and the ids are addressed by their field offsets only; no meaning is assigned to any of them.
The _Hash_bytes library call (seed 0xc70f6907) and memcmp are library behavior, not node logic: the model takes the hash result as an input and compares key bytes directly.
A missing field is a modelling gap, not a binary behavior: the model raises ValueError, while the binary would read whatever bytes lie at that address.
A bucket header whose +0x00 field is null and a bucket count of zero are dereferenced / divided by the binary without a check; the model raises ValueError for those inputs instead of faulting.

The value lookup's bucketed match reaches its +0x10 value through the predecessor's +0x00 field; by construction that field holds the matched node, so the model returns the matched node's value directly.

census.note: Key lookup: nine direct calls, no tail jumps. Value lookup: eight direct calls plus one tail jump (0x5d8cfea, from inside the key lookup itself). No stored qwords, no RELATIVE addends for either routine.

distinct_from: Open PR #2400 (incrementer leaf 0x5d8d0b0): its sole site 0x5d69d70 calls this lookup at 0x5d69cb9 and branches on its return; the lookup's own semantics are claimed here for the first time, not there.
Open PR #2397 (field accessors 0x5d8d0c0/0x5d8d0d0/0x5d8d0e0): adjacent leaves on a different field; no address overlap.
No open PR title hit for 5d8cf70, 5d8ce90 or key-value-lookup; the lookup routine itself is not claimed by any open PR.

hash_path.hash_call: _Hash_bytes(key bytes, key length, seed 0xc70f6907) via PLT 0x63f0ee0
hash_path.match: stored hash at node+0x30 equals the computed hash, length at node+0x10 equals the key length, and either the length is zero or memcmp over that many bytes reports equal
hash_path.miss: a zero bucket slot, a null successor, or a successor whose stored hash % bucket_count differs from the bucket index

node_fields.+0x28: id dword handed to the value lookup

key_lookup.miss_return: 0, returned directly (not through the value lookup)
key_lookup.path_selection: qword at map+0x18: greater than 20 (unsigned) takes the hash path, otherwise the small path

small_path.head: qword at map+0x10
small_path.match: length at node+0x10 equals the key length, and either the length is zero (no memcmp) or memcmp over that many bytes reports equal
small_path.miss: a null head or a null successor

node_fields.+0x28: id dword handed to the value lookup

key_lookup.takes: map object in rdi, key (pointer, length) in rsi

bucketed_path.match: first value node whose id dword at +0x08 equals the sought id, reached through its predecessor's +0x00 field; returns the matched node's +0x10 value
bucketed_path.miss: a zero bucket slot, a null successor, or a successor whose id % bucket_count differs from the bucket index

value_lookup.match_exit: 0x5d8cfea tail jump from the key lookup passes rdi unchanged and esi = matched node's +0x28 dword
value_lookup.path_selection: qword at map+0x50: zero takes the small path, nonzero takes the bucketed path

small_path.head: qword at map+0x48
small_path.match: first value node whose id dword at +0x08 equals the sought id; returns its +0x10 value (0 when that value is itself 0)
small_path.miss: a null head or chain exhaustion, returning 0

value_lookup.takes: same map object in rdi, id dword in esi (zero-extended)
